cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: The Handoff Already Happened
cards.instruction: Get them to accept responsibility by returning to earlier offers until the task seems to have been assigned all along.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. You said you'd take it from here. Here are the unanswered wedding invitations.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I meant I'd answer the door.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Exactly. These people need an answer before reaching it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then help me explain where your generous offer ended.

mechanism: A controls the interpretation of an earlier offer so answering a door becomes responsibility for the invitation replies that precede it.
confusable: D220 expands harmless approval; D221 repeatedly cites an earlier offer as if assignment already occurred.
comparison: Wedding entrance logistics differ from making a promised banner's advertised event real.
seedUse: Keep door-versus-reply correction and repeat actual earlier wording rather than generic generous-offer commentary.
